exposure: gestational age groups (24-32 weeks, 33-34 weeks, 35-36 weeks, and 37-43 weeks)
cohort: 13,361 preterm-born children and 13,361 matched term-born control children aged 1-10 years
finding: Increasing prematurity was associated with increased respiratory symptoms, particularly wheezing, in childhood, independent of a family history of atopy.
